purpose: Find late change-point locations and assess whether localized 10-sample-median HAC intervals improve worst-scenario true-slope coverage and loss vs SG046.

rule.score: For each split, linearly detrend each segment and estimate residual AR1 rho and RMS; score = abs(rho_after-rho_before)+0.35*abs(log(RMS_after/RMS_before)); choose highest score. Flag if score > frozen threshold.
rule.threshold_calibration: 95th percentile of max-scan scores among 280 control calibration streams without a known t=60 late switch; scenario labels used only for calibration, never online inference.
rule.estimate: When flagged, fit OLS trend on 10-sample medians of data from estimated change point through t=239, estimate Newey-West HAC SE lag 3, apply split-calibrated local multiplier 5.346129511387088. When unflagged use whole240 HAC and multiplier 2.291027529910169.
rule.decision: Confirm if interval excludes zero; reject if entirely within (-0.0032,.0032); otherwise unresolved. Sample cost .06 each; FP 150, FN 90, abstain 18.
rule.comparators: SG046 original frozen flag and frozen calibration as published, plus a full240 global calibration fitted on SG047 calibration set.

pilot.disclosure: Negative pilot fully inspected before freeze; rule retained without tuning.

limits: Onset at continuation t=0 is not identifiable from continuation-only data and should never be scored as a successfully localized internal change.
Late-oscillation onset t=60 is observable but oscillation onset is not the same as AR1 parameter shift.
Known labels inform false-alarm threshold calibration; do not claim purely unsupervised threshold selection.
Retrospective full240 analysis, no saved observations, no live change-point action.
Coverage under changing correlation may not be exchangeable; all confidence statements empirical.
